name: sankhya-hub-desktop
description: Shell desktop do Sankhya Hub (Electron) — Fase 2 da migração descrita em docs/specs/sankhya-hub-desktop-especificacao.md. Sucessor de produção da PoC em ../poc-desktop.

scripts.start: npm run build:hub && npm run build && electron .
scripts.empacotar: npm run build && node scripts/preparar-hub.mjs && node scripts/preparar-autosync.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.empacotar:sem-autosync: npm run build && node scripts/preparar-hub.mjs && node scripts/preparar-autosync.mjs --sem-autosync && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.empacotar:rapido: npm run build && node scripts/preparar-hub.mjs --sem-build && node scripts/preparar-autosync.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir
